capabilities: Render html-effect code blocks for compare, timeline, diagram, report, slides
Open .html files in a rendering viewer inside Obsidian
Rewrite relative image paths to Obsidian resource URLs
Edit rendered HTML in place and save over the original file
Export the current note as a standalone HTML file
disambiguation: Not a general HTML-to-Markdown converter; it renders HTML blocks and files, and can also export a note out as HTML.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later. The viewer iframe uses allow-scripts, so rendered HTML can run JavaScript. A <meta name="he-no-zoom"> tag disables the automatic width-scaling wrapper. Interface follows the Obsidian UI language (English/Chinese).
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown linearly and only shows the source of .html files, so comparisons, timelines, dashboards, and AI-generated HTML reports cannot be viewed properly inside the vault.
summary: Plugin that renders spatial HTML code blocks in notes and opens standalone .html files in a viewer with relative-path image rewriting.
